plugins.name: memory-kit
plugins.description: Persistent memory for your coding agent: a hot cache injected every session and held under three size caps, per-session handoffs, agent-audited promotion into knowledge articles and rules — plus optional orchestration and QA layers as lazy-loaded skills. Installs into any existing repository.
